catalog.applies_to: Technology Innovation Institute as the creator of the Falcon model families it trains and announces. Not the institute's non-AI research programmes, and not any host that only serves or redistributes Falcon weights.

notes: Human origin approval only. It records where TII publishes primary release information so a later refresh run can cite those origins; it adds no creator, family, release, product or deployment to the dataset, and it does not make TII a pilot creator or move it off the unanimous 3-of-3 long-tail bar of ADR 0002.

creator_id is the id the dataset already records: web/src/data/organizations.json carries id "tii", name "Technology Innovation Institute", website https://www.tii.ae/, checked on 2026-09-02. It is not a new naming decision.

This document approves exactly one origin, https://www.tii.ae, which was absent from both of gate-source-approval.mjs's trust anchors before it. Measured at merge base be72a5db on 2026-09-02: anchor 1 (web/src/data/sources.json) held 241 source records across 44 origins and anchor 2 (source_catalog[].url across tools/updater/profiles/**/*.json) held 24 origins, and www.tii.ae was in neither.

No Hugging Face organization is catalogued here. huggingface.co is already a trusted origin through existing dataset sources, and no TII organization page on it was checked in this review, so nothing here is evidence about which org there is TII's own.

source_catalog.trust_notes: TII's own news section; authoritative for what TII announces as its own work, including its Falcon model announcements. Deliberately bounded to /news, the only section checked: www.tii.ae is a multi-disciplinary institute site whose root is a corporate landing page (HTTP 200, <title>Technology Innovation Institute UAE | Advanced Tech Research Center</title>) and whose /careers path redirects off-host to careers.tii.ae, neither of which says who trained a model. Within /news the feed is the whole institute's rather than an AI feed, so a post here is not by itself a model release. Authoritative for what TII says it built and released, never for how any third party serves it.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-09-02: https://www.tii.ae/news returned HTTP 200, <title>Latest News | Technology Innovation Institute(TII)</title>, on the TII-owned www.tii.ae host, with the index carrying the string 'Falcon'. A named article under the approved path was fetched as a specific check — /news/technology-innovation-institute-introduces-worlds-most-powerful-open-llm-falcon-180b returned HTTP 200, <title>Technology Innovation Institute Introduces World’s Most Powerful Open LLM: Falcon 180B | Technology Innovation Institute</title>, carrying both 'Falcon 180B' and 'Technology Innovation Institute'. Two controls confirm the check discriminates rather than reporting 200 for anything: a fabricated slug under the same approved path returned HTTP 404 with <title>Page not found | Technology Innovation Institute</title>, so the section is not a soft-200 catch-all, and the fabricated host zzfabricated-control.tii.ae did not resolve at all.

deferred_origins.reason: Reached 2026-09-02: HTTP 200, <title>Introducing the Technology Innovation Institute’s Falcon Perception Making Advanced AI accessible and Available to Everyone, Everywhere</title>. It is a separate origin from www.tii.ae — trust attaches to scheme and host, and a shared registrable domain is not a shared origin — and it reads as a product and marketing surface for the Falcon line rather than the institute's publication channel. Approving it was not part of the reviewed grant this document records; it would be its own reviewed change.

deferred_origins.decision: already-trusted generic host, not re-approved here
deferred_origins.reason: Already trusted through existing dataset source records, so nothing here needs to re-approve it. No TII organization page on it was checked in this review, and a host is not approved because it distributes a creator's weights.

Reached indirectly on 2026-09-02, as the target of a redirect from www.tii.ae/careers (HTTP 200, <title>Careers at Technology Innovation Institute | Technology Innovation Institute jobs</title>). A recruitment site says nothing about who trained a model. Recorded so the redirect is not mistaken later for evidence that the careers section sits inside the approved origin: it does not, and /careers is outside allowed_paths in any case.

ambiguities.topic: The institute's name against its own root page
ambiguities.note: As checked on 2026-09-02 the dataset records the creator as 'Technology Innovation Institute', the news index titles itself 'Technology Innovation Institute(TII)', and the site root titles itself 'Technology Innovation Institute UAE | Advanced Tech Research Center'. Nothing checked here states a rename, and nothing checked establishes the relationship between the institute and any parent research council.
ambiguities.guidance: Record the name the source uses and keep the existing 'tii' id. Do not merge the institute with a parent body, and do not assert a corporate relationship between them; that is an organization mapping for a human.

ambiguities.topic: /news is an institute feed, not an AI feed
ambiguities.note: TII describes itself as an advanced technology research centre, and its single news section carries items from research programmes other than the AI work that produces Falcon.
ambiguities.guidance: Treat only a post that announces a model as evidence of a release. Do not infer an AI fact from a post about another programme, and do not treat the feed's post count as a release count.

ambiguities.topic: Falcon is a family line and a product surface at once
ambiguities.note: Falcon names the model families TII announces on /news and also the separately hosted falconllm.tii.ae surface, which presents Falcon as something users adopt.
ambiguities.guidance: Keep creator, family, release and product apart even where TII uses one name for all of them. Attribute a capability to a release only where the source does.
